title: Sparkly skateboard
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='deckGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff9a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd93d'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='deckGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e85555'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#e88a4c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8c93d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Deck shape: rounded board with kicked-up nose and tail -->
  <path d='M12,55 Q10,55 9,52 L8,48 Q7,45 10,44 L18,42 Q34,38 50,38 Q66,38 82,42 L90,44 Q93,45 92,48 L91,52 Q90,55 88,55 L82,56 Q66,59 50,59 Q34,59 18,56 Z'
        fill='url(#deckGrad)' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Deck edge/shadow line for contrast -->
  <path d='M12,55 Q10,55 9,52 L8,48 Q7,45 10,44 L18,42 Q34,38 50,38 Q66,38 82,42 L90,44 Q93,45 92,48 L91,52 Q90,55 88,55 L82,56 Q66,59 50,59 Q34,59 18,56 Z'
        fill='none' stroke='#e8c93d' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Grip tape strip on top -->
  <path d='M20,45 Q34,41 50,41 Q66,41 80,45 L81,47 Q66,43 50,43 Q34,43 19,47 Z'
        fill='#b06ee8'/>

  <!-- Trucks (axle mounts) -->
  <rect x='24' y='58' width='6' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#8e9aaf'/>
  <rect x='70' y='58' width='6' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#8e9aaf'/>

  <!-- Axles -->
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='14' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#c0cad8'/>
  <rect x='66' y='62' width='14' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#c0cad8'/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='67' r='6' fill='#5ce1e6' stroke='#8ef0f4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='67' r='2.2' fill='#3bb8bc'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='67' r='6' fill='#5ce1e6' stroke='#8ef0f4' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='67' r='2.2' fill='#3bb8bc'/>

  <!-- Sparkles around the skateboard -->
  <!-- Top-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(8,28)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(90,26)'>
    <polygon points='0,-7 2,-2 7,0 2,2 0,7 -2,2 -7,0 -2,-2' fill='#fff176'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(95,50)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#ffea75'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Small left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(4,42)'>
    <polygon points='0,-4 1,-1 4,0 1,1 0,4 -1,1 -4,0 -1,-1' fill='#ffea75'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(15,82)'>
    <polygon points='0,-5 1.3,-1.3 5,0 1.3,1.3 0,5 -1.3,1.3 -5,0 -1.3,-1.3' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bottom-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(84,80)'>
    <polygon points='0,-6 1.5,-1.5 6,0 1.5,1.5 0,6 -1.5,1.5 -6,0 -1.5,-1.5' fill='#ffe66d'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Tiny sparkles -->
  <g transform='translate(48,24)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff59d'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(60,18)'>
    <polygon points='0,-2.5 0.7,-0.7 2.5,0 0.7,0.7 0,2.5 -0.7,0.7 -2.5,0 -0.7,-0.7' fill='#fff59d'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(40,88)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3.5 1,-1 3.5,0 1,1 0,3.5 -1,1 -3.5,0 -1,-1' fill='#fff176'/>
  </g>
  <g transform='translate(62,86)'>
    <polygon points='0,-3 0.8,-0.8 3,0 0.8,0.8 0,3 -0.8,0.8 -3,0 -0.8,-0.8' fill='#fff176'/>
  </g>
</svg>
